source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of amino acids (PDF 129-130).

blocks.text: Amino acids compounds ka ahem group hain jin mein basic amino group (-NH2) aur tezaabi carboxylic acid group (-COOH) dono hote hain. Is liye yeh amphoteric hain: tezaab aur base dono ki tarah kaam kar sakte hain. Alpha-amino acids (2-aminocarboxylic acids) ki aam banawat H2N-CH(R)-COOH hai.

Alpha-amino acid aik dipolar ion ki shakal mein hota hai jise zwitterion kehte hain, jis ke aik hi molecule mein musbat aur manfi sire hote hain. Zwitterion banne mein aik proton carboxyl group se amino group par jata hai: H3N+-CH(R)-COO-. Is dipolar banawat ko internal salt bhi kehte hain.

R group woh hissa hai jo amino acids mein badalta hai. Sab se saada amino acid glycine (aminoethanoic acid) hai, jis mein R hydrogen atom hai; alanine (2-aminopropanoic acid) mein R methyl group, -CH3, hai. Glycine ke siwa sab alpha-amino acids chiral hain. Proteins mein taqreeban bees alpha-amino acids milte hain; kitab kehti hai ke 10 zaroori (jism inhein nahi bana sakta) aur 10 ghair zaroori hain, halanke zyada tar fehriston mein balighon ke liye nau zaroori diye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: H2N-CH(R)-COOH, alpha-amino acid, teer H+ ke jaane se zwitterion H3N+-CH(R)-COO- dikhata; glycine mein R = H aur alanine mein R = CH3, aur glycine ke siwa sab chiral. Neeche: kam pH par cationic shakal H3N+-CH(R)-COOH, pH = pI par dipolar ion, aur zyada pH par anionic shakal H2N-CH(R)-COO-, pH axis ke saath OH- aur H+ teeron se jureen.
blocks.caption: Amino acids, zwitterions aur mukhtalif pH par maujood shakalein (kitab ke structures ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Amino acid apna tezaab aur base saath rakhta hai. -COOH group usi molecule ke -NH2 group ko proton deta hai, jis se zwitterion banta hai. Tezaab milane se carboxylate par proton wapas aata (cationic shakal); alkali milane se -NH3+ ka proton hat jata (anionic shakal).

blocks.prompt: Glycine wahid aam alpha-amino acid kyun hai jo chiral nahi?
blocks.explanation: Is ke alpha carbon par do hydrogen atoms hain (R = H), is liye chaar mukhtalif groups nahi.

items: Glycine R = H (achiral); alanine R = CH3.
